up: Return the exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, standard_type) and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614342.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614342';
